description:
RELATIONSHIP SALES 1.2.2

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xSFWSga1sdjAgMGF_JJVhg6lnOGeQwRu/view?usp=sharing

Any good Indy knows who's good for business and who isn't.

Not compatible with Trios -- you'll need manual installation. So far 100% compatible with other mods. Safe to add to games. Should be safe to remove from them as well. Apparently my work doesn't qualify for a mod thread, but in the spirit all the same, This mod is 100% AI free. I am unable to provide github, as I am not a programmer (thanks to raatle for code support!), but modders may use any of this work freely w/o need for consultations and/or credit.

Here it is, the most exciting ship you've seen all day*
Spoiler

*upcoming Extended Mode will make this one much more interesting.

How it works!

On the beginning of your campaign, Indie personnel will spawn at the Core Markets (usually, but not always Independent Markets). Depending on your reputation, they'll have ships to sell, similar to working with an arms dealer or a nanoforge-capacity salesman. However! These are refits-and-refurbs (similar to what the Pathers do, albeit slightly more sane), not nanoforge blueprint production. There are limited quantities available to reflect that, based on a fiscal limit. Use up the fiscal limit, and that market has no more side production left. Every month, each market regains (x) credits in production, and you'll eventually be able to place orders again. The economics of this are fully tweakable by the user.
All vendor names are atrocious puns. The OP considers this a feature and it will only get worse with time.

World/Market Flavor List (aka "show me the ships")
Asharu - Ugly broken derelicts that barely function

These sprites by Helmut except for Heron Nebula. They're awful, barely-functioning hulks. But they're dirt cheap and let players who've hit rock bottom get back on their feet.
Note that in spite of the paint-jobs, these are not "scrappy cheaper derelict boats for freedom-loving spacers with witty repartee."
These are poverty-class vessels. The scrappy derelicts versions will be coming, though I may need to get a custom hullmod in play to figure that out.

Orthrus - small selection of torpedo and rocket boats so they can "salvage honor" while the Heggies blast pirates

(L->R) Sundog, Terrier, Jackal Rocket/Torpedo Boats.
It ain't much, but you gotta step up and let the Heggies know you're there

Agreus - Salvage-oriented utility ships and decommissioned civilianized warships and combat freighters

(L->R)Rancher (drone tender), Factum (Salvage Freighter), Civilian Conversions (Cowboy, Burro, Sojourner, Mastiff, Courser, Coyote).
The Ko Combine's remnants in the Persean Sector specialize in breaking and hull-recycling work. It is a well-known adage that the better a ship is for military purposes, the worse it performs economically, and vice-versa. Agreus' hull conversions are more fragile than their fully-militarized original hulls, but far more practical, for the Captain who wants the highest possible burn and the lowest-possible logistics footprint.

Asher - Home of the Luddic Engineers
.
Redeemed, crew-safe Pather salvages, Atama Dreadnought, Leviathan Pather Counter-Refit.
"The Path departed from Ludd's Wisdom when it decided that people were expendable, whether that was in battle, or simply because they happened to live on the wrong world."

Eldfell - Mining is hugely important here, and that shows, as well as the ability to get parts direct-shipped from Kazeron

(L->R) Ankylo and Aurochs Mining Freighters, Beehive ((Axlemc131)) Freighter, Tricera upfit destroyer, Hwacha Convoy Escort, Bulowa and Chekan mining escorts, Thesean Industry Ship, Castor and Pollux Chimeric Freighter/Destroyer)
Eldfell sits in a privileged position, with vast financing from the Kazeronian conglomerates who underwrite it, combined with being a steady port of call for the vast numbers of miners working in the system.

Nortia(WIP) - Smuggling and solar-shielded logistics ships.

Smuggling and solar-shielded vessels.  Looks like a Dram. It isn't.
I'm a little bit slow-rolling Nortia until I can see how the update rolls out -- Askonian planets will be getting some direct attention, but not quite yet.

Nomios - Phase-skimming transports (requires relationship 50, these guys are secretive)

Why does Nomios need range-boosted phase-skimming transports? What are they doing?
(Nomios is secretive, rep50 required.

Cethlenn - tweaked or modded TT cast-offs, particularly Penetration Carriers.

(L->R) Sleipnir Tug ((Janitor101)), Comet, Erinyes, Termigant, Osprey Penetration Carriers, Fugu Point-Defense Destroyer. (Top): Tektar Freighter; Cuman, Scythian ((vanilla)) Missile Skirmisher Ships.
Cethlenn is well-aware that its position is precarious and depends largely upon Tri-Tachyon's incessant internal competition sheltering it under a pavise of benign neglect. But it's refitters are working on some surprises of their own, particularly "penetration carriers" designed to get behind enemy formations fast, delivering fighters to where they can hopefully pin down strike vessels before they phase for their attack runs.

Ilm(WIP) - Builds by Rich Weirdos, converted troop carriers (Valkyrie refits/rebuilds.)

(L->R) Hammerhead*, Chasmos Destroyer, Mangonel Artillery Ship, Wolverine and Whipsnake frigates, Custodes and Interdictor** Missile/Rocket Ships, Gemell combat freighter)
There's money to be made refitting on Ilm, particularly given the larger number of troop carriers which wind-up in system due to local Pather issues.
*Vanilla, with the oft-requested "forward facing rear turrets." Enjoy.
**This one could be just a skin rather than a spare ship, likely to convert that later to ease bloat.

Baetis - Baetis is a known locus of surveyors, and the ships available reflect this.

Nilgai, Nomad, Aspera, Daydream, Peregrinatio. Survey-and-settlement ships.
*I have dug like hell and been unable to find out who did the Nomad - I have modded it to what I believe qualifies as fair-use, but if somebody knows the maker pls lmk so I can harass them for a thumbs-up/go-remake on usage.

Umbra - No images(Vanilla Sprites). Pirate ships with variant mods/systems. Kite (Burn drive) Vanguard (Heavy Armor, etc), Manticore (resistant flux conduits), Enforcer (ECCM) built in.

Derinkuyu - Scrappy Mining Ships

(L->R) Anole, Ettin ((BigBeans)) Mining Ships, Packer, Overseer Drone Tenders
Corvus and Galatia are home to large numbers of small, scrappy mining outfits, some of whom turn pirate at need (or resentment of the Hegemony's heavy handed governance).

Nova Maxios(WIP) - Pirate and TT rebuilds and up-fits.

(L->R) Apex Civilianized Survey Ship, Brobdignagian, Narthex Carriers, Cicada, Burr, Flegel Convoy Escort Destroyers
Nova Maxios gets more than its fair share of derelict vessels nearby due to Kanta's presence, and what's more has the nano-forge capacity to engage in serious refitting.

Ailmar(WIP) - Explorarium refits and occasional vessels from Ailmar's delicate 'balance of outsiders' diplomacy.

(L->R) Penguin ((Passwalker)), Outcast ((Medikohl)) Light Carriers, Three Isopod-class Frigates ((Passwalker and Toopok4k3, w/ small tweaks to Oniscus)): Bathynomus pocket carrier, Oniscus Combat Freighter, Porcellio Artillery Frigate.
These vessels are "foreign" hulls from the Era of Leonis which would be politically inconvenient for Ailmar to field. Better to sell them to a perfectly respectable Independent Captain such as yourself.

This mod has 71 new ships as of 1.0, all of them niche, tweaked, or oddball builds, some odder than others -- some should be skins tbf but for some reason I am incompetent barely-competent at creating skin files directly.  This is a feature and not a bug: there will be more made. Getting many of the sprites generously given to the community in the Spiral Arms II thread has been an explicit goal of mine since I first started modding here. The mechanics isolate these ships to you, the player, so that you can have a VAST amount of in-game variety without that variety overwhelming the Vanilla vibe by reconstituting what ships constitute the Core Fleets.

To say that my finger is not on the pulse of the average SS player judging ships by whether they help one slap down triple-Ordos is a blatant understatement -- I have balanced these as close to vanilla or slightly sub-vanilla as possible. So I don't expect much conversation here. But if you're a lore-nut like me and can think of a pirate-or-pather-style tweak or a concept refit that some Indies might do to suit their local needs, slap the reply button: I'm all ears and am very likely to make/include it for you if the angle is vanilla-lore-plausible. As a designer I lean into missiles a lot harder than a lot of other modders -- I consider them the go-to munition for the poor and the flux-starved. That said, proper balance means that missile boats are much more likely to have built-in weapons in order to avoid "what do you mean I can't have 10 Harpoon MRM Pods on a Destroyer" syndrome.

Note for Nexereln Players
Nexereln Players: install the game manually. Delete rules.csv in the data/campaign folder and rename rules - Nex users to rules.csv. You will lose some of the relationship-interaction flavor, but the markets will continue to function regardless of owners.[/url]

Change Log:
1.22 -- Ailmar, Ilm, and Nova Maxios Hulls, setup for Nex users.  Revealed not to work with Trios, I don't have a solution there, you'll have to go manual.

Ailmar: relic-level derelicts with wired-in Hound cockpits/life-support.
Ilm: Valkyrie refits.
Nova Maxios: Apogee refits (including kind use of the Diaphane frigate sprite, thank you Kelsier).
Removed ver. 1.2.1 from google drive as it is now fully-deprecated.
1.21 -- Umbra/ARC hulls (limited selection)
1.2 -- Luddic Engineer added to Asher. Agreus, Baetis, and Asher will perform multi-faction reputation checks. Mod folder now compressed bc why didn't I do that before? Minor tweaks to ship descriptions. Slowly working to make the landing-post not look like crap and get better sprite images up.
1.1 -- Additional ships added and groundwork for the Luddic Engineer sub-sub-faction set up. Further rules.csv updates are coming which will offer MUCH higher-quality vessels (Baetis has some of these already), but the relationship condition checks for some groups will only make said vessels available to people who pass multi-faceted reputation checks.  E.G., don't expect to get the good stuff from an ARC representative if you're known as a friend to the Diktat. This may eventually make it "odd" for Nexereln players who will have market ownership change frequently.
